subject: [PATCH 2/2] mm/swap: publish cluster tables after reacquiring allocator locks

reviews.author: Nhat Pham (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that the Co-developer's Signed-off-by line was missing and offered Kairui Song to decide on the correct credit format.
reviews.raw_body:
I think I need a

Signed-off-by: Kairui Song <ryncsn@gmail.com>

here as well...

(Kairui - up to you if you feel like Co-developed-by + Signed-off-by
or Suggested-by + Acked-by is more appropriate here. I just filled in
the sketch you gave me.)

2026-11-06.patch_summary: This patch addresses a memory pressure scenario where swap_cluster_populate() publishes a table while its locks are dropped, allowing a cached allocator to consume and free the table before the populating allocator resumes. The patch ensures that cluster tables are published after reacquiring allocator locks, preventing stale reclaimers from returning isolated clusters to allocation. It also retains cluster locks through scans and restores locks on allocation failure, ensuring correct behavior in various scenarios.
